description: List project-scoped expenses (the Project → Costs → Expenses tab). These records have description, amount, expense_date, receipt_url, and notes - they do NOT carry invoice_number or po_number. For the records shown on the main AssetLab "Expenses" page (which include invoice_number, po_number, category, and asset/site links), use list_asset_costs instead. Filter by project, work order, or cost category. Amounts are bare numbers with no currency: call get_organization_settings for currency_code before stating one.

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.

name: list_expenses
title: List expenses
